purposes.LD-STD: Install and commission the device correctly.
purposes.LD-PRO: Complex or concealed installation; survey before confirming a quote.
purposes.TH-OLD: Remove, transport and document disposal of an old device.
purposes.BH-EXT: Extend manufacturer warranty coverage for a purchased term.
purposes.BH-ADP: Protect against risks outside warranty under defined coverage and exclusions.
purposes.BH-CMP: Protect specified main components by model and component code.
purposes.BT-FIL: Replace compatible filters at scheduled intervals.
purposes.BT-CLN: Clean, inspect and adjust the device for reliable operation.
purposes.BT-COR: Supply genuine filter kits by model and serial.
purposes.CS-VIP: Prioritize response time; repair costs are not automatically waived.
purposes.CS-WQ: Measure water quality and deliver reports; material replacement is excluded.
purposes.CS-APP: Provide proactive in-app advice, reminders and alerts.
purposes.TG-ALL: Combine packages with explicit quantities and terms for each benefit.
purposes.TG-SUB: Use a device under a subscription contract with conditional ownership transfer.
